arguments.quote: Ms. Brask told the court that she had received the 900-page case file only three days before this hearing and asked for an adjournment of two weeks to prepare the defence.

events.quote: The trial opened on 2 June 2025 at 10:05 before Presiding Judge Ilena Varda, sitting with two lay assessors.
Mr. Venn had been arrested at his home before dawn on 14 February 2025 and was questioned by police for two days.
She stated that she was first able to meet Mr. Venn on 21 February 2025, a week after his arrest.
